ARABIC — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ARABIC
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Guided Reading : Reading Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Guided Reading : Reading Fluency.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Reading : Reading Fluency.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Reading : Reading Fluency.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Guided Reading : Reading Fluency.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
